episodes.title: To Challenge the Sun
episodes.summary: Edward and Alphonse meet a so-called religious leader during their travels who can invoke miracles, once seeing his miracles in person, they set out to discover if he is using the fabled Philosopher's Stone.

episodes.title: Body of the Sanctioned
episodes.summary: Edward and Alphonse have to decide if they should reveal the truth behind Cornello's miracles and the possible devastating effects that revelation might have on the townspeople and their lives.

episodes.title: Mother
episodes.summary: The story line flashes back to a younger Ed and Al and tells how their mother died and their determination to bring her back to life.

episodes.title: A Forger's Love
episodes.summary: While on their way to seek out a man from their early childhood, Al and Ed arrive in a town haunted by a ghostly woman.

episodes.title: The Man with the Mechanical Arm
episodes.summary: Ed and Al are held hostage on a train.

episodes.title: The Alchemy Exam
episodes.summary: Ed and Al prepare for their Alchemy exam.

episodes.title: Night of the Chimera's Cry
episodes.summary: Shou Tucker must impress the state with his alchemy for his annual assessment.

episodes.title: The Philosopher's Stone
episodes.summary: Ed resigns as State Alchemist; Winry arrives.

episodes.title: Be Thou for the People
episodes.summary: Ed is assigned to inspect the progress in a small mining town.

episodes.title: The Phantom Thief
episodes.summary: Ed and Al stumble into an unpopular manhunt for a crowd-pleasing thief.

episodes.title: The Other Brothers Elric (1)
episodes.summary: Imposters parade as Ed and Al.

episodes.title: The Other Brothers Elric (2)
episodes.summary: Ed and Al discover the source of the strange malady.

episodes.title: Fullmetal vs. Flame
episodes.summary: Ed challenges Mustang to a fight.

episodes.title: Destruction's Right Hand
episodes.summary: Ed and Al search for a deserter alchemist.

episodes.title: The Ishbal Massacre
episodes.summary: While on the run, Doctor Marcoh confess to the Elrics.

episodes.title: That Which Is Lost
episodes.summary: Ed and Al return to their hometown for repairs.

episodes.title: House of the Waiting Family
episodes.summary: The Elrics return to their childhood village; Ed visits his monther's grave.

episodes.title: Marcoh's Notes
episodes.summary: Ed and Al scour the library for Dr. Marcoh's records; Scar battles Lust and Gluttony.

episodes.title: The Truth Behind Truths
episodes.summary: Ed and Al learn the secret ingredient for the Philosopher's Stone.

episodes.title: Soul of the Guardian
episodes.summary: Two guardians of Lab 5 unleash an assault on Ed and Al.

episodes.title: The Red Glow
episodes.summary: Ed discovers more about the experiments in the fifth laboratory.

episodes.title: Created Human
episodes.summary: Ed is nearly tricked by a face from his past.

episodes.title: Heart of Steel
episodes.summary: Winry needs to make repairs; Al questions his existence.

episodes.title: Bonding Memories
episodes.summary: Al joins Scar on a renegade mission against the state.

episodes.title: Words of Farewell
episodes.summary: Ed and Al give up their search for the Philosopher's Stone.

episodes.title: Her Reason
episodes.summary: Winry drags Ed and Al to Rush Valley.

episodes.title: Teacher
episodes.summary: Ed and Al are reunited with Izumi, their former teacher who gives the boys a traumatic interrogation.

episodes.title: One is All, All is One
episodes.summary: Hohenheim's visit ends with a harsh warning to Pinako; Ed finds hope and has confidence that Al can be returned to his body.

episodes.title: The Untainted Child
episodes.summary: The brothers encounter a strange boy.

episodes.title: Assault on South Headquarters
episodes.summary: A former military officer spots Scar; Izumi attacks the military.

episodes.title: Sin
episodes.summary: Izumi escapes with the boy; the brothers try to stop Izumi's plan of atonement.

episodes.title: Dante of the Deep Wood
episodes.summary: Izumi sends Ed and Al to meet the alchemist Dante.

episodes.title: Al, Captured
episodes.summary: Kidnappers take Al, leaving Ed frantic.

episodes.title: Theory of Avarice
episodes.summary: Greed transforms his body into an impervious shield and tells Ed he must kill him in order to save Al; Armstrong battles Greed and his men.

episodes.title: Reunion of the Fallen
episodes.summary: Lust wants to know where she came from, and where she will go when she dies; Lust meets a familiar man who provides answers and memories.

episodes.title: The Sinner Within Me
episodes.summary: Lust and Gluttony meet with Wrath for the first time; Ed, Al and Winry travel to Ishbal and continue to crack the mystery.

episodes.title: The Flame Alchemist, The Bachelor Lieutenant, & The Mystery of Warehouse 13
episodes.summary: Mustang gets investigated; an adventure with the Flame Alchemist and his loyal followers; mystery unfolds unknown relatives of Maj. Armstrong, and a haunted warehouse.

episodes.title: With the River's Flow
episodes.summary: Al questions Ed on their mission, creating tension between the two brothers; Sciezka and Winry come into contact with the dangerous Sloth.

episodes.title: Secret of Ishbal
episodes.summary: Marta leads Ed and Al to the ruins of Ishbal, and she tells them the true cause of the war and the reasons for her transformation; Ed and Al question everything they once believed.

episodes.title: The Scar
episodes.summary: Al intervenes when Marta tries to get revenge on Kimbley for her friends' deaths; the seventh sin is revealed.

episodes.title: Holy Mother
episodes.summary: Scar remains determined to create the Philosopher's Stone.

episodes.title: The Stray Dog
episodes.summary: Ed and Al begin their journey home; the Fuhrer declares the Elrics to be fugitives.

episodes.title: Hohenheim of Light
episodes.summary: Ed and Al must convince Mustang's faction that the Fuhrer is not what he seems.

episodes.title: One Who Lets Her Heart Rot
episodes.summary: The truth behind the truth is revealed; Colonel Mustang decides to challenge military leadership.

episodes.title: Human Transmutation
episodes.summary: The brothers find themselves in danger while separated.

episodes.title: Homunculus Sealed
episodes.summary: Tucker tries to resurrect his daughter; Sloth captures Al.

episodes.title: Farewell
episodes.summary: When Al gets kidnapped, Ed must rescue him; Mustang helps Ed.

episodes.title: Beyond the Gate
episodes.summary: Ed is sent to the other side of the gate, where his understanding of alchemy is questioned.

episodes.title: Death
episodes.summary: Ed battles Envy in order to free Al.

episodes.title: Laws and Promises
episodes.summary: Ed and Al demonstrate what they will sacrifice for each other.
